description_en: Queries the script for adding existing nodes to a cluster node pool. If you need to add existing ECS instances to an ACK cluster as worker nodes or re-add removed worker nodes to a node pool, you can manually add the existing nodes to a node pool. You can call this operation to obtain the script for adding existing nodes
description_zh: 如果需要将已有ECS实例添加到ACK集群中作为Worker节点，或移除Worker节点后需将节点实例重新加入节点池，ACK支持手动将已有节点到节点池。您可以调用DescribeClusterAttachScripts接口获取添加已有节点的脚本
name: DescribeClusterAttachScripts

parameters.help_en:
The CPU architecture of the node. Valid values: `amd64`, `arm`, and `arm64`.

Default value: `amd64`.

Required when the cluster type is ACK Edge
parameters.help_zh:
节点CPU架构。支持的CPU架构包括`amd64`、`arm`、`arm64`。

默认值：`amd64`。

当集群类型为边缘托管版时必填
parameters.name: arch

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the generated token. The time is in the UNIX timestamp format. For example, 1739980800 indicates 2025-02-20 00:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 描述生成的 token 的过期时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳，如示例的1739980800 表示 2025-02-20 00:00:00
parameters.name: expired

parameters.help_en:
[Deprecated] Use `format_disk_option` instead.
`true`: Equivalent to setting `format_disk_option` to `DataDisk`.
`false`: Equivalent to setting `format_disk_option` to `SystemDisk`
parameters.help_zh:
【已废弃】请使用`format_disk_option`
`true`: 等价于`format_disk_option`为`DataDisk`。

parameters.name: format_disk

parameters.help_en:
The disk formatting method. This parameter is mutually exclusive with `format_disk` when `format_disk` is set to `true`. Valid values:

`SystemDisk`: No additional initialization is performed. Container runtime data is stored on the system cloud disk or any disk that is already mounted to the relevant directory during import.
`DataDisk`: If a data cloud disk or local disk is mounted, the last disk is formatted and mounted to store container runtime data.
`NodePoolDiskConfig`: Initializes data cloud disks based on the configurations of the imported node pool. Cloud disks and elastic ephemeral disks are matched based on the `disk_name` field of the node pool and the `DiskName` field of the block storage. Local disks are matched sequentially based on the PCI address order. Node pool configurations that do not match any disk are ignored.

<warning>The `DataDisk` option is retained only for historical compatibility and is strongly discouraged.
This option uses the last disk in lexicographical order of device names under `/dev` (NVMe is preferred). Note that nvme9 takes precedence over nvme10. Operating systems with newer kernels such as Alinux 4 cannot guarantee a stable device order.
</warning>

Disks with a recognizable file system during import skip the formatting step and are directly mounted
parameters.help_zh:
格式化磁盘的方式，不能与`format_disk`为`true`同时指定。取值：

`SystemDisk`: 不执行额外初始化操作，容器运行时数据将存储在系统盘，或任何在导入时已经挂载在相关目录的盘上。
`DataDisk`: 如已挂载数据盘或本地盘，格式化并挂载最后一块盘用于存储容器运行时数据。
`NodePoolDiskConfig`: 按导入的节点池的配置初始化数据盘。云盘/弹性临时盘按照节点池`disk_name`字段和块存储的`DiskName`字段匹配。本地盘按PCI地址顺序依次匹配。未匹配到对应磁盘的节点池配置将被忽略。

<warning>`DataDisk`选项仅因历史兼容性原因保留，强烈不推荐使用。
该选项使用`/dev`下设备名字按典序最后一块盘（优先使用NVMe），注意nvme9将优先于nvme10。Alinux 4等较新内核的操作系统无法保证稳定设备顺序。
</warning>

导入时已有可识别文件系统的磁盘会跳过格式化步骤，并直接挂载
parameters.name: format_disk_option

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the instance name when adding an existing instance to the cluster. If you do not retain the instance name, the instance name format is `worker-k8s-for-cs-<clusterid>`. Valid values:

`true`: Retains the instance name.
`false`: Does not retain the instance name. The instance name is replaced based on system rules.

Default value: `true`
parameters.help_zh:
添加已有实例到集群时，是否保留实例名称。如果不保留，则实例名称格式为`worker-k8s-for-cs-<clusterid>`。取值：

`true`：保留实例名称。
`false`：不保留实例名称，会用系统规则进行替换。

默认值：`true`
parameters.name: keep_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the node pool. Specifies the node pool to which the node is added.

If you do not specify a node pool ID, the node is added to the default node pool by default
parameters.help_zh:
节点池ID，添加节点时可以将该节点添加到指定的节点池中。

如果不指定节点池ID，默认将节点添加至默认节点池
parameters.name: nodepool_id

parameters.help_en:
The access configuration parameters for the node.

Required when the cluster type is ACK Edge
parameters.help_zh:
节点的接入配置参数。

当集群类型为边缘托管版时必填
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en: If an ApsaraDB RDS instance list is specified, the ECS instances of the cluster nodes are automatically added to the RDS access whitelist
parameters.help_zh: 如果指定了RDS实例列表，集群节点ECS会自动加入RDS访问白名单
parameters.name: rds_instances
